serverInfo.name: 1stay
serverInfo.description: 1Stay — Hotel booking for AI conversations. Search 250,000+ properties worldwide across major brands (Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt, Wyndham, Best Western, Choice) and independent/boutique hotels. Get live rates, room details, and cancellation policies. Book with a secure checkout link — guest pays the hotel directly and receives the hotel's own confirmation number. Loyalty points apply to every booking. Displayed totals include taxes and any applicable, itemized 1Stay Booking Fee.
